name: La Guancha (Spain)
description: Green field with a white diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly.
history: The flag of La Guancha was approved by the Government of the Canary Islands by order of 3 December 1991, its length being one and a half times its height; if the flag bears the arms they are placed at the centre. The municipality also has a standard, approved by the same order, of emerald green silk or satin with a white rectangle at the centre and a fringe of silver and green.

features.role: band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
